thesis: Fastest to connect, hardest to get paid: no capacity payment, and battery revenue has fallen steeply as the fleet grew, on the market monitor's figures. Even with a toll the model falls short of the fund's target, so only an executed toll at a known price makes a case.
并网最快，回款最难：没有容量付费，且据市场监测机构数据，随着储能规模扩大，电池收入大幅下滑。即便有租赁，模型测算仍达不到基金目标回报，因此只有价格明确的已签署租赁才能成立。

label: February 2027 MORA: review winter adequacy and battery availability
2027年2月资源充裕度月报：复核冬季供需与电池可用性
note: ERCOT targets each MORA for the first Friday of the month, two months ahead of the reporting month, as the January 2027 MORA states; the first Friday of December 2026 is 4 December. It informs demand and saturation; it is not evidence of a toll price.
据2027年1月资源充裕度月报所述，ERCOT计划于每月第一个星期五发布月报，提前两个月覆盖报告月份；2026年12月的第一个星期五为12月4日。该报告反映需求与饱和程度，但不能作为租赁价格的依据。

label: January 2027 MORA: review winter evening adequacy and battery availability
2027年1月资源充裕度月报：复核冬季晚高峰供需与电池可用性
note: ERCOT issues the MORA on the first Friday of each month, two months ahead of the reporting month (December 2026's was published on 2 October 2026). It informs demand and saturation; it is not evidence of a toll price.
ERCOT于每月第一个星期五发布资源充裕度月报，提前两个月覆盖报告月份（2026年12月月报于2026年10月2日发布）。该报告反映需求与饱和程度，但不能作为租赁价格的依据。

text: ERCOT published the January 2027 MORA on schedule. Winter risk is low: the riskiest hour is the morning, 8 a.m., at a 3.20% chance of an Energy Emergency Alert against ERCOT's 10% threshold, and evening hours stay near 1%. Storage keeps arriving: 21,528 MW installed, 807 MW more than in the December report, with 12,525 MW expected available at the riskiest hour; low wind is the main risk. A new battery sub-model slightly lowers the estimated risk. Nothing here prices a toll, so the call is unchanged.
ERCOT按时发布2027年1月资源充裕度月报。冬季风险低：风险最高的时段在早上8点，触发电力紧急警报的概率为3.20%，低于ERCOT的10%门槛；晚间时段约为1%。储能继续增加：装机21,528MW，比12月月报多807MW，风险最高时段预计可用12,525MW；主要风险来自低风电出力。新增的电池子模型使估算风险略有下降。报告不涉及租赁定价，因此投资判断不变。

label: Toll · 2h
租赁 · 2小时
why: No capacity payment exists and battery revenue has fallen steeply as the fleet grew; a toll is the only secured route, and no ERCOT toll price has been disclosed.
这里没有容量付费，且随着储能规模扩大，电池收入大幅下滑；租赁是唯一的锁定收入途径，而ERCOT的租赁价格从未公开。

text: Read the February 2027 MORA on 4 December for winter adequacy and battery availability. Engage only with an executed toll: get its price and test it against the market monitor's 2025 battery revenue before any bid.
于12月4日阅读2027年2月资源充裕度月报，复核冬季供需与电池可用性。只考虑已签署租赁的项目：出价前取得租赁价格，并与市场监测机构公布的2025年电池收入对比检验。
